title: Analytics & Reporting
summary: Live recruitment KPI dashboards, source effectiveness, diversity and funnel reports.
headline: See what’s working. *Fix what isn’t.*
lede: Every hire leaves a trail of data. TalentPool365 turns it into simple, live reports, so you can improve speed, quality and cost across your whole recruitment process.
sectionIntro: Every hire leaves a trail of data. TalentPool365 turns it into simple, live reports, so you can improve speed, quality and cost across your whole recruitment process.

capabilities.title: Recruitment KPI Dashboard
capabilities.tagline: Your hiring scorecard, always up to date.
capabilities.body: Live view of time-to-hire, cost-per-hire and offer acceptance. Track your core hiring metrics in real time with filters for role, team, location and period.
points: Live view of time-to-hire, cost-per-hire and offer acceptance
Filters by role, team, location and period
One-click shareable reports for leadership
Executive trend lines and benchmark comparisons

capabilities.title: Source Effectiveness
capabilities.tagline: Know which channels bring your best hires.
capabilities.body: Compare job boards, employee referrals, agency submissions and social sourcing to see where your highest performing candidates actually originate.
points: Compare job boards, referrals and social sourcing
Track quality and hires per source, not just applicant volume
Reduce spend on channels that don’t convert
Cost-per-qualified-candidate breakdown by channel

capabilities.title: Diversity Analytics
capabilities.body: Measure pipeline equity and stage progression with aggregated, anonymized insights that protect candidate privacy while surfacing systemic drop-offs.
points: Anonymized, aggregated pipeline insights
Spot stages where candidates drop off unevenly
Track progress toward your inclusion goals
Compliance reporting ready for audit review

capabilities.title: Hiring Funnel Analysis
capabilities.tagline: Find the bottleneck, then remove it.
capabilities.body: Inspect conversion rates and time elapsed between every recruitment milestone. Discover where delays happen and streamline the hand-offs.
points: Conversion rate and time spent at every stage
Drop-off insights from application to joining
Compare funnels across roles and teams
Diagnostic alerts when stage dwell time exceeds threshold

capabilities.title: Recruiter Productivity
capabilities.tagline: Better insight, better support for your team.
capabilities.body: View activity and outcomes across your talent acquisition team to balance workloads, identify coaching opportunities and celebrate top performers.
points: Activity and outcomes by recruiter
Workload balance across the team
Benchmarks that show where coaching helps
Capacity planning for future hiring surges

closingCta.headline: Make every hiring decision a data-backed one.
closingCta.body: See how TalentPool365 turns recruitment data into actionable hiring power.
